about: Our own example of a fork: the same North three months on, made from A Hard Winter in the North.

data.fiction: Fiction: a starting point for a story game. Not news and not a forecast.
data.title: A Hard Winter: the Thaw
data.blurb: Made from A Hard Winter in the North. The ice breaks, the ports open, and the North counts what the winter cost.
data.opening: Fiction. The thaw comes late but all at once. The ports reopen, the ration cards are put away, and the pacts that held through the winter become something more: Norway and Sweden talk openly of an alliance, and every capital in the region asks who stood by it and who did not.

facts.text: The winter of 2027 closed the Baltic ports for eleven weeks; Norway's ports and Swedish rail carried the region through it.
Norway and Sweden have begun talks on a full alliance, the first in their modern history.
Every leader in this story is an invented person, named by office only.
